title: Nvidia Launches Independent Investigation into CEO Over Security Concerns
subtitle: The tech giant is looking into the relationship between Jensen Huang and a suspected foreign intelligence asset.

summary.en: Nvidia has hired a top law firm to investigate its CEO, Jensen Huang, following reports of a personal relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. The company is currently facing significant market pressure and legal challenges regarding these security concerns. Huang has admitted to being unfaithful to his wife, though he did not confirm the identity of the woman involved. Experts suggest that the investigation is critical because of Huang's central role in the company's strategy. The U.S. government has noted that this situation highlights the importance of national security in the technology sector.
summary.zh: 輝達已聘請頂尖法律事務所調查其執行長黃仁勳，起因是有報導指出他與一名疑似中國間諜的女子有私情。該公司目前正因這些安全疑慮面臨巨大的市場壓力與法律挑戰。黃仁勳已承認對妻子不忠，但未證實涉案女子的身分。專家認為，由於黃仁勳在公司策略中扮演核心角色，這項調查至關重要。美國政府則指出，此事件凸顯了國家安全在科技產業中的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia, the massive chipmaker worth $4.1 trillion, has taken a major step to address a growing scandal. The company’s board of directors has hired a leading New York law firm, Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz, to lead a thorough and independent investigation. This move comes after reports surfaced that Nvidia’s CEO, Jensen Huang, had a personal relationship with a woman who is believed by U.S. intelligence agencies to be a Chinese spy.
paragraphs.zh: 市值高達四點一兆美元的晶片巨頭輝達（Nvidia），已採取重大行動以應對日益嚴重的醜聞。該公司董事會已聘請紐約頂尖法律事務所「瓦奇特爾、立普頓、羅森與卡茲」（Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz），主導一項全面且獨立的調查。在此之前，有報導指出輝達執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）與一名被美國情報機構認定為中國間諜的女子有私情。

paragraphs.en: The investigation will be led by Joon Kim, a partner at the law firm and a former government prosecutor. According to The Guardian, Kim is an expert in internal investigations and crisis management. The company stated that a committee of independent board directors will oversee the process. While Nvidia has not provided a specific timeframe for the investigation, they have confirmed that Huang will continue to lead the company without interruption.
paragraphs.zh: 這項調查將由該法律事務所的合夥人、同時也是前政府檢察官的瓊恩·金（Joon Kim）負責。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，金是內部調查與危機處理方面的專家。輝達表示，一個由獨立董事組成的委員會將監督調查過程。雖然輝達尚未提供具體的調查時程，但已證實黃仁勳將繼續領導公司，職務不會受到影響。

paragraphs.en: The situation has caused significant trouble for the tech giant. After reports of the affair first appeared, Nvidia saw its market value drop by hundreds of billions of dollars. On Sunday, Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife, though he did not directly name the woman involved. Nvidia had previously denied that any improper relationship existed. The company is now also looking into reports that suggest Huang may have been the target of a foreign intelligence effort, according to The Guardian.
paragraphs.zh: 這起事件已對這家科技巨頭造成嚴重困擾。在婚外情報導首次出現後，輝達的市值蒸發了數千億美元。週日，黃仁勳承認對妻子不忠，但他並未直接點名涉案女子。輝達先前曾否認存在任何不當關係。據《衛報》報導，該公司目前也正在調查相關報導，這些報導暗示黃仁勳可能成為外國情報工作的目標。

paragraphs.en: This scandal is particularly sensitive because of the role Jensen Huang plays at Nvidia. As reported by NPR, Huang is not just a typical executive; he is the only CEO the company has ever had. He is deeply involved in every part of the business, from strategy to government relations. NPR noted that his staff are highly devoted to him, and the company’s structure is built entirely around his leadership. Because of this, many investors are worried about what a leadership crisis could mean for the company’s future.
paragraphs.zh: 這起醜聞之所以特別敏感，是因為黃仁勳在輝達扮演的角色。據美國公共廣播電台（NPR）報導，黃仁勳不僅是一位典型的執行長，他更是該公司創立以來唯一的執行長。他深度參與業務的每一個環節，從策略規劃到政府關係皆然。NPR 指出，他的員工對他極為忠誠，公司的架構完全圍繞著他的領導風格建立。正因如此，許多投資人對於領導危機可能對公司未來造成的影響感到擔憂。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the company itself, the situation has caught the attention of U.S. officials. David Perdue, the U.S. ambassador to China, spoke to Bloomberg Television about the broader implications of the story. He explained that this situation serves as a reminder that the country must remain careful. Perdue noted that national security and economic security are closely linked, especially when it comes to the technology industry. He added that the current relationship between the U.S. and China is quite difficult.
paragraphs.zh: 除了公司內部，此事件也引起美國官員的關注。美國駐中國大使大衛·普度（David Perdue）在接受彭博電視台（Bloomberg Television）訪問時，談到了此事件更廣泛的意涵。他解釋說，這起事件提醒了國家必須保持警惕。普度指出，國家安全與經濟安全息息相關，尤其是在科技產業方面。他並補充，目前美中關係相當艱難。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia’s importance to the global economy cannot be overstated. The company is a leader in artificial intelligence, and Huang has personally promised billions of dollars in investments to help other companies grow their own AI capabilities. Because he acts as a primary face for the U.S. technology industry, his personal actions have become a matter of national interest. As NPR reported, Huang is the opposite of a hands-off manager; he is involved in every detail of the business, which makes the current uncertainty even more challenging for shareholders.
paragraphs.zh: 輝達對全球經濟的重要性不言而喻。該公司是人工智慧領域的領導者，黃仁勳個人已承諾投入數十億美元，協助其他企業發展自身的 AI 能力。由於他被視為美國科技產業的主要門面，他的個人行為已成為國家利益相關的議題。正如 NPR 所報導，黃仁勳絕非那種放任不管的管理者；他參與業務的每一個細節，這使得當前的局勢不確定性對股東而言更具挑戰性。

paragraphs.en: Despite the negative news, there have been some signs of stability. According to The Guardian, Nvidia shares saw a recovery on Wednesday, closing up 2.9%. This helped the company recover some of the value it had lost since the news first broke. The market was also helped by positive reports from CoreWeave, an AI infrastructure company that saw its own revenue grow significantly.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管負面消息不斷，但已出現一些穩定的跡象。根據《衛報》報導，輝達股價在週三出現回升，收盤上漲百分之二點九。這協助公司收復了部分自新聞爆發以來損失的市值。市場也受到 AI 基礎設施公司 CoreWeave 的正面報告所提振，該公司營收出現顯著成長。

paragraphs.en: As the investigation continues, the focus remains on whether the CEO’s actions created any real risk to national security. The law firm chosen by Nvidia is well-known for its experience in high-stakes corporate matters. Founded in the 1960s, Wachtell is considered one of the most prestigious firms in the United States. Its history includes advising the U.S. Treasury during the 2008 financial crisis and handling some of the largest corporate takeovers in history. With such a firm in charge, the board hopes to find out the truth and restore confidence among investors and the public.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著調查持續進行，焦點仍集中在執行長的行為是否對國家安全造成任何實質風險。輝達選擇的這家法律事務所，以處理高風險企業事務的豐富經驗而聞名。瓦奇特爾事務所成立於一九六零年代，被視為美國最負盛名的事務所之一。其歷史包括在二零零八年金融危機期間為美國財政部提供諮詢，並處理過史上幾起最大規模的企業併購案。董事會希望透過這家事務所的協助，查明真相並恢復投資人與大眾的信心。

paragraphs.en: For now, the tech world is watching closely. The outcome of this investigation will likely determine not only the future of Jensen Huang at Nvidia but also how the company manages its relationships with foreign partners. As the U.S. continues to push for progress in artificial intelligence, the security of its leading technology companies remains a top priority for government leaders and business experts alike.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，科技界正密切關注此事。這項調查的結果，不僅可能決定黃仁勳在輝達的未來，也將影響該公司如何處理與外國合作夥伴的關係。隨著美國持續推動人工智慧的進步，確保頂尖科技公司的安全，仍是政府領導人與商業專家共同的首要任務。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To become known or apparent after being hidden or unknown.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 浮出水面；顯露；為人所知。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（表面），這裡作動詞，形容消息或事件被公開。文中：This move comes after reports surfaced that Nvidia’s CEO, Jensen Huang, had a personal relationship with a woman who is believed by U.S. intelligence agencies to be a Chinese spy.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Not involving direct control or management; letting things happen without interfering.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 不干預的；放任的；非直接管理的。
keyTerms.noteZh: 由片語組成，形容一種不插手的管理風格。文中：As NPR reported, Huang is the opposite of a hands-off manager; he is involved in every detail of the business, which makes the current uncertainty even more challenging for shareholders.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To describe something as being larger, more important, or more serious than it really is.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常與 cannot 連用，表示「再怎麼強調也不為過」。文中：Nvidia’s importance to the global economy cannot be overstated.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To become public or be reported for the first time (often used for news).
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（打破），這裡指新聞事件突然爆發。文中：This helped the company recover some of the value it had lost since the news first broke.

quiz.question: Which of the following is true regarding the investigation into Jensen Huang?

options.A: The investigation is being conducted directly by the U.S. government.
options.B: A committee of independent board directors will oversee the investigation process.
options.C: Nvidia has announced that the investigation will be completed within a few weeks.
options.D: Jensen Huang has been suspended from his CEO duties while the investigation is ongoing.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，Nvidia 明確表示將由一個獨立董事委員會來監督調查流程。選項 A 錯誤，因為調查是由私人律師事務所 Wachtell 進行，而非政府直接主導。選項 C 錯誤，因為文章提到 Nvidia 並未提供具體的時間表。選項 D 錯誤，因為文章第二段結尾明確指出 Huang 將繼續領導公司，不會中斷職務。

quiz.question: Why are investors particularly concerned about the current scandal involving Jensen Huang?

options.A: Because Nvidia is planning to replace Huang with a new CEO immediately.
options.B: Because the scandal has caused the company to lose its leadership in the AI market.
options.C: Because the company's entire structure and strategic operations are heavily dependent on Huang's personal leadership.
options.D: Because the law firm hired by Nvidia has a history of failing to resolve corporate crises.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段與第六段，Nvidia 的運作完全圍繞著 Huang 的領導，他不僅是唯一的 CEO，還深度參與戰略與政府關係，且不是一個「放手型」管理者。因此，當他陷入危機時，投資人會擔心公司運作受到影響。選項 A 文章未提及要更換 CEO。選項 B 誇大了影響，文章僅提到股價下跌，未說失去市場領導地位。選項 D 與文章第八段描述該律師事務所聲譽卓著的事實相悖。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the phrase 'hands-off manager' imply about Jensen Huang?

options.A: He prefers to delegate tasks and avoid getting involved in daily operations.
options.B: He is physically unable to perform his duties due to the scandal.
options.C: He is a leader who focuses exclusively on international relations.
options.D: He is someone who strictly follows the rules set by the board of directors.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在商業情境中，「hands-off manager」意指「授權型」或「不過度干涉的管理者」。文章提到 Huang 是「the opposite of a hands-off manager」（與之相反），說明他事必躬親，因此 hands-off 本身的意思就是不插手細節。選項 B 與生理狀態無關。選項 C 範圍太窄，未涵蓋其對公司業務的全面參與。選項 D 並非該詞彙的核心定義。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: To explain the history and success of Nvidia as an AI leader.
options.B: To detail the personal life and family background of Jensen Huang.
options.C: To discuss the legal strategies used by Wachtell to defend corporate executives.
options.D: To examine the implications of a leadership scandal at a key tech company on national security and market stability.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章從 Huang 的醜聞出發，探討了其對股價的衝擊（第三段）、對公司運作的潛在風險（第四段）、對國家安全的影響（第五段）以及後續的調查措施（第八段），涵蓋了事件的廣泛影響。選項 A 只是背景資訊。選項 B 僅是事件起因，非全文核心。選項 C 僅是文章的一部分，並非文章要探討的主要議題。
